name: top-nav-shell
title: Top navigation shell
description: An app frame with the navigation along the top: brand, links with the current one marked, search, actions and account, then the page in a container.
docs: Pass links with currentHref (the current link gets aria-current) and your router's Link as linkAs. search, actions and account are slots: from md (or lg, see collapse) they sit in the sticky header, and below that width the links, the search and the actions move into a sheet opened from the menu button while the account stays in the header. pageHeader takes the PageHeader props and is drawn at the top of the content. collapse sets where the row takes over from the menu: md (default) fits four short links next to a labelled action, and five links need collapse="lg" (they want about 820px). With the default, a SearchTrigger shrinks to its icon between md and lg so the row never crowds. The menu closes by itself if the window grows past that width, and the search fills the menu whatever width class it carries. The header gets its bottom border once the page scrolls, measured with an IntersectionObserver. width sets the container to 72rem (default), 80rem or the whole width. Five areas or fewer fit the row; beyond that use a sidebar shell.
